CreateSLB.title: CreateSLB
CreateSLB.description:
## Usage notes

An SLB instance is a network-layer dependency that provides services for external connections and supports failover. It attaches a domain name to the IP addresses of ClickHouse nodes. The SLB instance balances and forwards cluster requests to internal nodes to distribute traffic in a multi-node deployment. It also performs health checks on backend nodes. If a node becomes unavailable, the SLB instance checks its health status and automatically isolates it. This ensures that request traffic is distributed to active nodes.

- **CloudDisk**: disk encryption.

- **off**: Encryption is disabled.

The maintenance window of the cluster. The time is in the HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ format (UTC).

- **CloudESSD**: ESSD PL1 disk.

- **CloudESSD\_PL2**: ESSD PL2 disk.

- **CloudESSD\_PL3**: ESSD PL3 disk.

- **CloudEfficiency**: Ultra Disk.

LockMode.description:
The lock mode of the cluster. Valid values:

- **Unlock**: The cluster is not locked.

- **ManualLock**: The cluster is manually locked.

- **LockByExpiration**: The cluster is automatically locked upon expiration.

- **LockByRestoration**: The cluster is automatically locked before a data rollback.

- **LockByDiskQuota**: The cluster is automatically locked because its storage is full.

- **26842**: China site (aliyun.com).

- **26888**: International site (alibabacloud.com).

- **true**: Expired.

- **false**: Not expired.

Progress.description:

> This parameter is returned only when the cluster status is **SCALING\_OUT**.

Ratio.description:
The data migration progress, formatted as `Migrated data size/Total data size`.

> This parameter is returned only when the cluster status is **SCALING\_OUT**.

LbKind.description: The type of the load balancer.

EncryptionKey.description:
The KMS key.

> This parameter is empty if the encryption type is `off`.

DBClusterType.description:
The type of the cluster. Valid values:

- **Common**: a standard cluster.

- **Readonly**: a read-only cluster.

- **Guard**: a disaster recovery cluster.

ExpireTime.description:
The time when the cluster expires. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

> For pay-as-you-go clusters, this parameter is empty.

DBNodeStorage.description:
The storage capacity of a single node, in GB.

Valid values: 100 to 32000.

> The value must be a multiple of 100.

DBNodeClass.description:

- For a single-replica cluster, valid values are:

  - **S4-NEW**

  - **S8**

  - **S16**

  - **S32**

  - **S64**

  - **S104**

  - **C4-NEW**

  - **C8**

  - **C16**

  - **C32**

  - **C64**

  - **C104**

The reason why the cluster is locked.

> This parameter is empty if the lock mode is `Unlock`.

The status of the cluster. Valid values:

- **Preparing**: The cluster is being prepared.

- **Creating**: The cluster is being created.

- **Running**: The cluster is running.

- **Deleting**: The cluster is being deleted.

- **SCALING\_OUT**: The cluster is being scaled out.

DBClusterNetworkType.description: The network type of the cluster. Only VPC is supported.

Category.description:
The edition of the cluster. Valid values:

- **Basic**: single-replica.

- **HighAvailability**: dual-replica.

SupportMysqlPort.description:
Specifies whether the MySQL port is supported. Valid values:

- **true**: The MySQL port is supported.

- **false**: The MySQL port is not supported.

SupportHttpsPort.description:
Specifies whether the HTTPS port is supported. Valid values:

- **true**: The HTTPS port is supported.

- **false**: The HTTPS port is not supported.

ControlVersion.description:
The version of the backend management system. Valid values:

- **v1**

- **v2**

PublicIpAddr.description: The IP address of the public endpoint.

EngineMinorVersion.description: The current minor version of the engine.

EngineLatestMinorVersion.description: The latest minor version to which the cluster can be upgraded.

MaintainAutoType.description: Specifies whether upgrades are performed automatically. A value of **false** indicates that manual upgrades are required.

<props="china">

- **CloudESSD\_PL0**: ESSD PL0 disk.

</props>


- **CloudESSD**: ESSD PL1 disk.

- **CloudESSD\_PL2**: ESSD PL2 disk.

- **CloudESSD\_PL3**: ESSD PL3 disk.

- **CloudEfficiency**: Ultra Disk.

ExtStorageSize.description: The extended storage capacity in GB.
